data: {{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Republic |image=[[File:AvaluPorviran.jpg]] |name=Avalu Porviran |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}} |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[Galactic Senate]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Avalu Porviran''' was a [[human]] [[senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] in [[132 BBY]].{{TheAcolyteDate}} Senator Porvivan was a senator from the [[Bormea sector]] who approached the debates with an open mind.''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' In 132 BBY, Proviran served on a tribunal convened at the request of [[Worus Rayencourt]] to determine whether the Senate should exercise oversight of the [[Jedi Order]]. Rayencourt convinced Supreme Chancellor [[Veeth Drellik]] to convene a tribunal, though [[Vernestra Rwoh]] ultimately convinced the tribunal that Master [[Sol]] was solely responsible for the murders. This allowed Vernestra to conceal much from the Senate and pin the blame on Sol. Since he was deceased, no one could verify this with him. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Soruces== *{{ThisWeek|e6uYc0Yl0vU|Dispatch: The Stranger and The Acolyte}} {{Video}} *{{SW|url=news/ilm-the-acolyte-vfx-interview|text=Lightsabers & Magic: Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy on The Acolyte's Creatures and Weapons of the Jedi}} {{Po}} *{{SWYouTube|9ajCIM6U5UA|The Acolyte | The Costumes of The Acolyte | Disney+}} {{Video}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Avalu Porviran}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ავალუ პორვირანი |nl=Avalu Porviran }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Porviran, Avalu}} [[Category:Galactic Republic senators during the High Republic Era]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
